# Image Lab

> Image Lab edits images entirely inside your browser: remove or replace
> backgrounds, extract a colour palette, swap or delete colours, adjust,
> crop, resize, rotate, redact and convert formats. Nothing is uploaded.

## What it does

- Removes a subject's background, with an outline-and-shadow cutout style.
- Replaces the background with a solid colour, gradient or image.
- Extracts a colour palette from an image, and swaps, deletes or duotones
  colours.
- Adjusts brightness, contrast, saturation and sharpness.
- Simulates colourblindness (deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia).
- Redacts parts of an image by pixelating or blocking them out.
- Crops, resizes and upscales, rotates and flips.
- Dithers to Floyd-Steinberg or Atkinson, in colour or monochrome.
- Vectorizes a raster image to SVG, in colour, line art or pixel-art mode.
- Converts between PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF and SVG.
- Batches the same edits across multiple images at once.

## How it works

Every edit runs locally using WebAssembly and, where available, the GPU. No
image is uploaded, stored on a server, or seen by anyone else.

## Pages

- [Image Lab](https://images.modul4r.com/): drop an image and start editing.
